issues.description:
Method return type mismatch for Stock.take(String):
- Problem statement (UML) declares Stock.take(String): int (uses -1 as failure sentinel).
- Solution implementation defines public int take(String ingredient) and callers (SealSaloon.checkOrderReady) compare the result to -1 to detect insufficient stock.
- Template implementation defines public boolean take(String ingredient) (returns true/false).
This mismatch is high-impact: students following the template signature cannot implement the SealSaloon logic described in the specification (which expects an int return and -1 sentinel) and will face compilation/type-errors or be forced to deviate from the exercise requirements.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template Stock.take method to match the problem statement and solution: change the signature from 'public boolean take(String ingredient)' to 'public int take(String ingredient)'. Implement the method to return the new quantity on success or -1 on failure (e.g., when ingredient not found or quantity < 1). This keeps the sentinel-based logic consistent with the UML/spec and allows SealSaloon.checkOrderReady to compile and operate as intended.
